Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. The search results clearly displayed two different entries for "Thomas Carr": one for the film director (died 1957) and one for the DC Comics director/actor (died 1997). The agent incorrectly extracted the death date of 1997 from the IMDb entry for the DC Comics director and applied it to the film director Thomas Carr. This error led to the incorrect conclusion that Thomas Carr (died 1997) died after Frank R. Strayer (died 1964), whereas the correct death date for the film director Thomas Carr is 1957, which is earlier than 1964. The agent should have identified the correct Wikipedia entry (Thomas Carr (director)) which explicitly lists the death date as April 23, 1957.
